responsibility: Declares the public target helper interfaces shared across the VAX backend implementation and generated machine-description support code. It exposes address legitimacy checks, prologue expansion, PIC operand validation, CC-mode selection, operand/address printers, DImode add/sub expanders and move splitters, integer instruction output helpers, and floating-value range checking, providing the prototypes needed by vax.cc, vax.md output code, and other target headers.
